body: Komi Store is growing, so I'm putting together a small team to help maintain it. It's passed 16k stars and has around 72 open issues, and right now one person handles the whole thing ^^. I'm looking for a few developers and a couple of people to help run the community. If that's you, open the latest blog post on the Komi Store website for the details.
title: Komi Store is growing, and I'm building a maintainer team
